name: Sophia Ende
source:
Sophia has a heart of gold. She doesn't know how to be suspicious of people, and is easily deceived. Raised by an old priest, she is not used to young men and has little knowledge about sex. She may seem like a model nun, but she often goes out of control in order to serve others.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.girls-software.com/doas/#character]official website[/url]]
